mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_feedback (user_id, session_id, message_id, user_message, ai_response, rating, feedback) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{userMessage}, #{aiResponse}, #{rating}, #{feedback})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM t_ai_feedback WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_ai_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_feedback SET rating = #{rating}, feedback = #{feedback}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
